note: finalChecklist and commitSubjects below are recorded documentation from the actual live /tdd run that produced e2e/'s current git history: .tdd/checklist.json is gitignored, so it exists on the machine that ran it but not in this repo. e2e/smoke.mjs does NOT assert testCount against git log or a live checklist.json -- a legitimate future commit touching e2e/, or a fresh machine with no .tdd/checklist.json on disk, would break an exact-match assertion for no real reason. Use these as the comparison target when a human runs the full live workflow end to end; see AGENTS.md's 'Running the plugin against itself' section. testCount is the one figure smoke.mjs does assert, because pytest's own summary line is a stable, resettable ground truth that does not depend on any gitignored file.
